generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: The intending Bidder should have satisfactorily executed the above said works as prime contractor in a single work order of value not less than Rs. 60.13lakhs (Excluding GST) in any thermal power station of 210MW capacity or above/reputed private organization in any one year during the preceding FIVE FY years. Work done value of previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of the financial year, in which tenders are invited. The intending Bidder shall upload the work order and work done/work completion certificates as a documentary proof issued by the Competent Authority. On demand original shall be produced for verification.

The bidder shall be a NABL Accredited lab in the field of solid fuel coal testing and should have experience in sampling of coal from moving belts, top wagon of the rake, raw coal feeders of mills, coal sample preparation in TPP or any reputed private organization handling coal. A valid NABL Accreditation certificate shall be submitted.

The Bidder should have achieved a minimum annual financial turnover of Rs.240.50 lakhs (exclusive of GST) in any two of the preceding FIVE financial years. The intending Bidder shall upload the Profit and Loss statement duly certified by chartered accountant as a documentary proof. On demand original shall be produced for verification. Financial turnover of previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to present price level of the financial year in which tenders are invited.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

technicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder shall not have been subject to forfeiture of EMD/foreclosure/termination of their contract in KPCL/government or any other utility and have not been blacklisted for participation in tender issued by KPCL or government or any other utility in India during the past 5 years
The intending bidder shall submit undertaking as per Annexure 1A
